zh-CN.title: 瑞利分辨极限计算器
zh-CN.intro: 瑞利分辨极限计算器求圆孔衍射的最小可分辨角 θ=1.22λ/D，适合望远镜、显微镜与相机镜头的分辨率极限评估。
zh-CN.desc: θ_min = 1.22·λ / D

en-US.title: Rayleigh Resolution Limit Calculator
en-US.intro: Find the minimum resolvable angle for circular-aperture diffraction, θ = 1.22λ/D. For evaluating the resolution limit of telescopes, microscopes and camera lenses.

zh-CN.title: 由明视距离与焦距求简单放大镜角放大率
zh-CN.intro: 输入明视距离 N（约 25 cm）与简单放大镜焦距 f，按 M = N / f 计算角放大率。用于放大镜、放大镜组的光学放大能力估算。
zh-CN.desc: 由明视距离与焦距求简单放大镜角放大率

en-US.title: Angular Magnification Calculator (M = N/f)
en-US.intro: Compute angular magnification from the near-point distance N (about 25 cm) and the focal length f of a simple magnifier. For estimating the magnifying power of loupes and magnifier arrays.

zh-CN.title: 由曲率半径求球面镜焦距
zh-CN.intro: 球面镜焦距计算器依据 f=R/2 由曲率半径求凹/凸面镜焦距，适合几何光学、望远镜与反射镜设计的参数换算。
note: 凹面镜 R、f 取正，凸面镜取负。
zh-CN.desc: 由曲率半径求球面镜焦距

note: 凹面镜 R、f 取正，凸面镜取负。

en-US.title: Spherical Mirror Focal Length Calculator (f = R/2)
en-US.h1: Spherical Mirror Focal Length Calculator (f = R/2)
en-US.intro: Derive the focal length of a concave or convex mirror from its radius of curvature using f = R/2. For geometrical optics, telescopes and reflector design.

zh-CN.title: 由源频率、相对速度与光速求观测频率
zh-CN.intro: 输入源频率 f、相对速度 v 与光速 c，求观测频率（近似非相对论）。
zh-CN.desc: 由源频率、相对速度与光速求观测频率

en-US.title: Optical Doppler Shift Calculator (f′ = f·(1 + v/c))
en-US.h1: Optical Doppler Shift Calculator (f′ = f·(1 + v/c))
en-US.intro: Compute the observed frequency from source frequency, relative velocity and the speed of light, using the non-relativistic approximation.

zh-CN.title: 由折射率与顶角求小角度棱镜偏向角
zh-CN.intro: 输入棱镜材料折射率 n 与顶角 A（小角度近似），按 δ ≈ (n − 1)·A 计算光线偏向角。用于色散棱镜、分光元件的偏折估算。
note: 近似式适用于小顶角棱镜。
zh-CN.desc: 由折射率与顶角求小角度棱镜偏向角

note: 近似式适用于小顶角棱镜。

en-US.title: Prism Deviation Angle Calculator (δ ≈ (n − 1)·A)
en-US.intro: Compute the deviation angle from prism refractive index n and apex angle A under the small-angle approximation. For dispersing prisms and beam-steering elements.

zh-CN.h1: 球面镜成像公式计算器
zh-CN.title: 球面镜成像公式 1/f = 1/d_o + 1/d_i
zh-CN.intro: 输入凹/凸面镜焦距、物距，按 1/f = 1/d_o + 1/d_i 计算像距并判断成像正倒、虚实、大小。用于中学物理与光学成像练习。
zh-CN.desc: 球面镜成像公式 1/f = 1/d_o + 1/d_i

en-US.title: Spherical Mirror Equation Calculator
en-US.intro: Enter focal length and object distance to get image distance from 1/f = 1/dₒ + 1/dᵢ, plus orientation, real/virtual and size. For school physics and imaging practice.

zh-CN.h1: 斯涅尔定律折射计算器
zh-CN.title: 斯涅尔定律折射计算器
note: 光从空气入玻璃会向法线偏折。
zh-CN.intro: 斯涅尔定律折射计算器由入射角与两侧折射率求折射角 n₁sinθ₁=n₂sinθ₂，并判断是否全反射，适合几何光学与光纤传输分析。
zh-CN.desc: 斯涅尔定律折射计算器

note: 光从空气入玻璃会向法线偏折。

en-US.title: Snell's Law Refraction Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute the refraction angle from incidence angle and the two refractive indices using n₁sinθ₁ = n₂sinθ₂, and detect total internal reflection. For geometrical optics and fiber transmission.

zh-CN.h1: 薄透镜成像公式计算器
zh-CN.title: 薄透镜成像公式 1/f = 1/d_o + 1/d_i
zh-CN.intro: 薄透镜成像公式计算器依据 1/f=1/dₒ+1/dᵢ 由物距与焦距求像距，并判断正倒立与虚实，适合几何光学成像习题与镜头设计。
zh-CN.desc: 薄透镜成像公式 1/f = 1/d_o + 1/d_i

en-US.title: Thin Lens Equation Calculator
en-US.intro: Get image distance from object distance and focal length using 1/f = 1/dₒ + 1/dᵢ, plus upright/inverted and real/virtual. For geometrical optics exercises and lens design.

zh-CN.title: 由波长、屏距与缝距求条纹间距
zh-CN.intro: 输入光波波长 λ（纳米）、屏距 L（米）与双缝间距 d（毫米），按 Δy=λL/d 计算杨氏双缝干涉相邻明（暗）条纹的间距，用于物理实验。
note: 间距与波长成正比、与缝距成反比。
zh-CN.desc: 由波长、屏距与缝距求条纹间距

note: 间距与波长成正比、与缝距成反比。

en-US.title: Young's Double-Slit Fringe Spacing Calculator (Δy = λL/d)
en-US.h1: Young's Double-Slit Fringe Spacing Calculator (Δy = λL/d)
en-US.intro: Compute the spacing between adjacent bright (or dark) fringes from wavelength λ in nanometres, screen distance L in metres and slit separation d in millimetres. For physics labs.

zh-CN.title: 由两透镜焦距与间距求组合焦距
zh-CN.intro: 输入两薄透镜焦距 f₁、f₂ 与间距 d，按 1/F = 1/f₁ + 1/f₂ − d/(f₁f₂) 计算组合系统等效焦距。用于组合镜头、望远镜目镜组设计。
zh-CN.desc: 由两透镜焦距与间距求组合焦距

en-US.title: Separated Lenses Focal Length Calculator (1/F = 1/f₁ + 1/f₂ − d/(f₁f₂))
en-US.h1: Separated Lenses Focal Length Calculator (1/F = 1/f₁ + 1/f₂ − d/(f₁f₂))
en-US.intro: Compute the equivalent focal length of two thin lenses with separation d. For compound lenses and telescope eyepiece group design.

zh-CN.title: 菲涅尔反射率计算器
zh-CN.intro: 菲涅尔反射率计算器求正入射时界面反射的能量比例，由两介质折射率确定，适合增透膜、窗口与光纤端面的反射损耗估算。
zh-CN.desc: R = ((n₁−n₂)/(n₁+n₂))²

en-US.title: Fresnel Reflectance Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute the fraction of energy reflected at normal incidence from the refractive indices of two media. For anti-reflection coatings, windows and fiber end-face loss estimates.

zh-CN.title: 由膜厚、折射率与级次求相消波长
zh-CN.intro: 输入薄膜折射率 n、厚度 t（纳米）与干涉级次 m，按 2nt=(m+½)λ 计算垂直入射时产生相消干涉的波长，用于镀膜与增透设计。
note: 肥皂膜呈彩色即薄膜干涉。
zh-CN.desc: 由膜厚、折射率与级次求相消波长

note: 肥皂膜呈彩色即薄膜干涉。

en-US.title: Thin-Film Destructive Interference Calculator (2nt = (m+½)λ)
en-US.intro: Compute the wavelength that interferes destructively at normal incidence from film index n, thickness t in nanometres and order m. For coating and anti-reflection design.

zh-CN.title: 由孔径与波长求圆形孔径分辨本领
zh-CN.intro: 输入圆形孔径直径 D 与光波长 λ（纳米），按 R = D / (1.22·λ) 计算分辨本领与极限分辨角。用于望远镜、显微镜与相机分辨率评估。
zh-CN.desc: 由孔径与波长求圆形孔径分辨本领

en-US.title: Resolving Power Calculator (R = D/(1.22·λ))
en-US.intro: Compute resolving power and limiting resolution angle from circular aperture diameter D and wavelength λ in nanometres. For telescopes, microscopes and camera resolution.

zh-CN.title: 单缝衍射暗纹计算器
zh-CN.intro: 单缝衍射暗纹计算器求夫琅禾费单缝衍射第一暗纹角 a·sinθ=λ，适合物理实验、光学测量与衍射现象的定量分析。
zh-CN.desc: a·sinθ = m·λ（m=1,2,…）

en-US.title: Single-Slit Diffraction Minima Calculator
en-US.intro: Find the first dark-fringe angle of Fraunhofer single-slit diffraction from a·sinθ = λ. For physics experiments, optical measurement and quantitative diffraction analysis.

zh-CN.title: 由膜厚、折射率与级次求相长波长
zh-CN.intro: 输入薄膜折射率 n、厚度 t（纳米）与干涉级次 m，按 2nt=mλ 计算垂直入射时产生相长干涉的波长，用于薄膜光学与反射增强分析。
note: 垂直入射、两相长条件近似。
zh-CN.desc: 由膜厚、折射率与级次求相长波长

note: 垂直入射、两相长条件近似。

en-US.title: Thin-Film Constructive Interference Calculator (2nt = mλ)
en-US.intro: Compute the wavelength that interferes constructively at normal incidence from film index n, thickness t in nanometres and order m. For thin-film optics and reflection enhancement.

zh-CN.title: 由焦距求透镜光焦度（屈光度）
zh-CN.intro: 透镜光焦度计算器依据 P=1/f（f 以米计）将焦距换算为屈光度（D），适合验光配镜与光学系统的光焦度统一。
note: P 为正为会聚、负为发散。
zh-CN.desc: 由焦距求透镜光焦度（屈光度）

note: P 为正为会聚、负为发散。

en-US.title: Optical Power Calculator (P = 1/f)
en-US.intro: Convert focal length in metres to optical power in diopters using P = 1/f. For optometry, eyeglass prescription and unified optical system power.

zh-CN.title: 组合透镜焦距计算器
zh-CN.intro: 组合透镜焦距计算器求密接双透镜的等效焦距 1/f=1/f₁+1/f₂，适合光学系统设计中多片透镜的焦距合成与换算。

en-US.title: Combined Lens Focal Length Calculator
en-US.intro: Get the equivalent focal length of two cemented thin lenses from 1/f = 1/f₁ + 1/f₂. For combining and converting focal lengths in multi-element optical design.

zh-CN.title: 由起偏光强与偏振片夹角求透射光强
zh-CN.intro: 输入线偏振入射光强 I₀ 与检偏器夹角 θ，按马吕斯定律 I = I₀·cos²θ 计算透射光强。用于偏振片、液晶显示与光学实验分析。
zh-CN.desc: 由起偏光强与偏振片夹角求透射光强

en-US.title: Malus's Law Calculator (I = I₀·cos²θ)
en-US.intro: Compute transmitted intensity from linearly polarized incident intensity I₀ and the analyzer angle θ. For polarizers, LCDs and optics lab analysis.

zh-CN.title: 光学放大率计算器
zh-CN.intro: 光学放大率计算器求横向放大率 m=−dᵢ/dₒ（负号表示倒立），适合几何光学成像、显微镜与投影系统的像放大分析。
zh-CN.desc: M = −d_i / d_o

en-US.title: Optical (Transverse) Magnification Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute transverse magnification m = −dᵢ/dₒ, where the minus sign denotes an inverted image. For geometrical optics imaging, microscopes and projection systems.

zh-CN.title: 布儒斯特角计算器
zh-CN.intro: 布儒斯特角计算器求反射光完全偏振时的入射角 θ=arctan(n₂/n₁)，适合光学薄膜、偏振片与反射消除等场景的参数确定。
zh-CN.desc: θ_B = arctan(n₂ / n₁)

en-US.title: Brewster's Angle Calculator
en-US.intro: Find the incidence angle at which reflected light is completely polarized, θ = arctan(n₂/n₁). Useful for optical coatings, polarizers and glare reduction.

en-US.title: Refractive Index from Light Speed Calculator
en-US.h1: Refractive Index from Light Speed Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute the refractive index of a medium from the speed of light in it, n = c/v.
